paper.title_en: Quark dipole operators in the gradient-flow scheme at NNLO QCD
paper.abstract_en: Conversion factors for the dimension-five QCD operator basis from the $\overline{\textrm{MS}}$ to the gradient-flow scheme are presented through NNLO in the strong coupling. In the CP-even sector, the results are provided for general quark masses and arbitrary flavor content of the operators. Specifically, this concerns the quark CMDM operator and its mixing with lower-dimensional QCD operators. In the massless case, our results immediately apply to the quark chromoelectric dipole operator. As a by-product, we also determine missing entries in the $\overline{\textrm{MS}}$ anomalous dimension matrix of the CMDM operator to NNLO QCD.
